LESSON: WRITING 5.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING – POETRY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Poetry, part of Strand 5 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: how language is used in poetry, • compare language use in poetry with ordinary language. Why are poems important in transmitting culture?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work collaboratively to discuss aspects of poetry (e.g. theme, diction, line, stanza, imagery and persona),

2. watch a presentation of, or read a simple poem on the theme,

3. explain the main message from the poem,

4. identify aspects of style (e.g. repetition, rhyme, imagery, symbolism, and rhythm),

5. compose simple poems on community values,

6. recite the verses for peer review,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work collaboratively to discuss aspects of poetry (e.g. theme, diction, line, stanza, imagery and persona),
2. watch a presentation of, or read a simple poem on the theme,
3. explain the main message from the poem,
4. identify aspects of style (e.g. repetition, rhyme, imagery, symbolism, and rhythm),
5. compose simple poems on community values,
6. recite the verses for peer review,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner speaks engagingly when discussing aspects of poetry.

• Creativity and Imagination: This is developed as the learner exchanges new ideas that inspire creativity when composing

simple poems on community values.
